key.name: recent-files
key.description: The 20 most recently opened file URIs, newest first, for document completion. Opening the buffer switcher removes missing files from this history; open editor buffers remain accessible to preserve unsaved work.

key.name: window-maximized
key.summary: Whether the editor window is maximized

key.name: session-files
key.description: Ordered file URIs to reopen at startup. Missing files are skipped. Untitled tabs are not included.

key.name: session-active-file
key.description: File URI selected in the editor before quitting. Reopened and selected at startup if it still exists, even if an empty Untitled document was selected afterward. Unsaved drafts are not stored.

key.name: org-indent-mode
key.description: Visually indent sections by heading depth and hide extra heading stars without modifying file contents.

key.name: show-line-numbers
key.description: Display line numbers beside the text in all file editors.

key.name: agenda-padding
key.description: Padding in pixels on all four sides of the textual Agenda view. Changes apply immediately and are independent of editor padding.

key.name: editor-padding
key.description: Padding in pixels on all four sides of every file editor. Changes apply immediately; heading tags align inside the padding without changing file contents.

key.name: auto-revert
key.summary: Automatically reload files changed on disk
key.description: Monitor open documents and reload externally changed files when there are no unsaved edits. Unsaved edits are preserved with a warning instead of being overwritten. Reloads keep the cursor position where possible and update Calendar and Agenda. Enabling this setting also checks already open files.

key.name: jj-escape
key.summary: Use a key sequence to escape Vim insert mode
key.description: The configured two-character sequence typed within the escape delay leaves insert mode without inserting text. An unmatched first character is inserted after the delay or before another key. Normal, visual, replace, and non-Vim editing are unchanged.

key.name: escape-sequence
key.description: Exactly two visible characters without spaces, such as jj or jk. Case-sensitive; Shift is supported. Apply changes in Preferences to activate the sequence.

key.name: zoom
key.description: Font size of the editor text, in percent of the default size.

key.name: agenda-directory
key.description: Folder whose .org files (including subfolders), together with open Org documents, are listed below the utility pane calendar. Each file has a stable color dot matching its calendar events. Click a file to edit it; use the checkmark on the right to include its entries in Calendar and Agenda. Calendar excludes scheduled entries and deadlines; Agenda includes them without a global TODO list. A leading ~ is expanded to the home folder.

key.name: hidden-agenda-files
key.summary: Files hidden from Calendar and Agenda
key.description: Canonical file URIs unchecked in the utility pane. Hidden files remain available in the editor, and visibility choices persist across sessions.

key.name: utility-file-order
key.description: Canonical file URIs in display order. Drag file rows above or below one another to reorder them. The order is shared across windows and restored between sessions; new files are appended. Unsaved drafts keep their position during the session but are not stored.

key.name: removed-files
key.description: Canonical file URIs excluded from the utility pane, Calendar, and Agenda. Remove leaves the file on disk; Move to Trash asks for confirmation. Explicitly opening a removed file adds it back.

key.name: file-colors
key.description: Canonical file URIs mapped to RGB hex colors chosen with Change Color in the file context menu. Colors apply to utility pane dots and calendar events; deadlines retain their warning color. Rename preserves the file color, visibility, list position, and unsaved editor contents. New and renamed files automatically use the .org extension, which is hidden in utility pane file names.

key.name: hide-weekends
key.description: Show only Monday through Friday in the weekly calendar without changing dated entries.
